en: Sepia-toned landscape view showing gently rolling terrain with fields and vineyards in the middle ground, surrounded by dense trees. On the far right stands a large multi‑storey building with a central tower or spire, possibly a manor house or small palace, with a flag flying on top. The horizon and what appears to be open water or distant flat land can be seen beyond the tree line. The photo has scalloped edges and some age-related stains, typical of early 20th‑century postcards. No visible printed or handwritten text is present on the image side.
